name: quak
title: Quak for Sonos
description: Play announcements, sounds and clips on your Sonos speakers with Quak (quak.party).
author: mlieser

commands.name: play-text
commands.title: Play Text
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Say a text on your speakers.

commands.name: play-selected-text
commands.title: Play Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Play the text selected in any app on your speakers.

commands.name: talk
commands.title: Talk to Speakers
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Record from the microphone and play it on your speakers (macOS only).

commands.name: play-sound
commands.title: Play Sound
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Search the sound library and play a sound on your speakers.

commands.name: play-clip
commands.title: Play Clip
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Play one of your workspace's clips on your speakers.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Announcements
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Stops announcements, sounds and clips on all speakers. Music keeps playing.

commands.name: history
commands.title: History
commands.subtitle: Quak
commands.description: Browse recent plays, replay them, stop them or save them as clips.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: From quak.party/app/settings/keys. Scope “play” is enough, “create” also saves plays as clips.

preferences.name: apiKey2
preferences.title: Second Workspace
preferences.description: Optional: a key for another workspace, switch with Switch Workspace (⌘⇧W) in the commands

preferences.name: apiKey3
preferences.title: Third Workspace
preferences.description: Optional: a key for another workspace, switch with Switch Workspace (⌘⇧W) in the commands
